shared: All statistics are sealed descriptive outputs. Model-gap ribbons are not confidence intervals. Daily profiles are illustrative AU Perth 2015, 349 days; PPO uses labeled seed 4. Clean classical top-SCI plot primitives enforced throughout.

fig2-g1.a: NASA POWER Jan-Oct temperature anomalies (1984-2026) over neutral era dividers with NL CLO NH4-N/NOx-N deposition trends (1980-2026) on the right axis.
fig2-g1.b: Unified five-breadbasket 5-regime stacks (Compliant, Surplus only, Surplus+Low NUE, NUE >0.90, Low NUE) paired with Org.N, Yield and Apparent NUE attribute bars.
fig2-g1.c: Tightly framed [35, 248] EUNEP Safe-Corridor phase space showing 52 farm-years with 1-sigma covariance ellipses (or 1D error bars where N input is fixed) and regional centroids.
fig2-g1.d: Two-row G1 scorecard: regional/macro 90% coverage (top), dual-scale BSS vs ExtraTrees (%) + raw Brier score across caps 25-50 (bottom left), and grouped width/regret reduction horizontal bars (bottom right).

fig2-p1-regimes.a: Tightly framed [0, 252] EUNEP phase space contrasting Soft-Coupled, PPO, DVS Full and Archived bare (52 farm-years each) with 1-sigma covariance ellipses and centroids.
fig2-p1-regimes.b: Nested 10-policy compliance tracks showing regional-stacked Joint compliance + 95% bootstrap CIs overlaid against Safe NUE (0.50-0.90) and Either-bound reach.
fig2-p1-regimes.c: Classical 2-row framed 349-day AU Perth 2015 dynamics: top soil mineral N + cumulative N loss; bottom daily rainfall + S1/S2/S3 N doses.
fig2-p1-regimes.d: Aligned 2-row bilateral corridor distributions across 6 core policies: Apparent NUE [0.50, 0.90] (top) and Realized Surplus S_N [0, 40 kg/ha] (bottom).

fig3-p2-transfer.a: Coupled 40-case held-out Realized Surplus S_N rainclouds (LORO density + LOYO median/IQR) alongside LOYO->LORO compliance dumbbells and Public NL n=4 diamonds.
fig3-p2-transfer.b: 2D generalization trajectories (World-Equal Grain N RMSE x Compliance, LOYO->LORO arrows with pooled-RMSE ticks, top) and paired-contrast 95% CI forest plot (Holm p = 1.00, bottom).
fig3-p2-transfer.c: Five-breadbasket bivariate (Realized S_N x Apparent NUE) transfer phase map showing Full64 LOYO->LORO centroid shifts, 1-sigma ellipses, Static3/ET64 markers and prior admission rates.
fig3-p2-transfer.d: Tightly framed [25, 248] Held-Out n=40 EUNEP phase space comparing LOYO (pink ellipse) vs LORO (slate-blue dashed ellipse) across Full64, Static3 and ExtraTrees64.

fig4-factorial-stress.a: 2D continuous iso-advantage phase contour across Surplus Cap (25-50 kg N/ha) x Warming (0 to +3.5C) showing 0 pp parity and +4/+5 pp cap-40 ridge with 12x3 econ glyphs.
fig4-factorial-stress.b: Cap-dependent warming crossover across Historical, +1.8C and +3.5C with LORO-region range envelopes and bottom-embedded 45-cell win/tie/loss strips.
fig4-factorial-stress.c: Five-regime Leave-One-Region-Out (LORO-Region) sensitivity dumbbells shaded across regional-drop envelopes.
fig4-factorial-stress.d: Directed 2D Pareto phase-plane trajectories (Partial Profit x Joint Compliance, 0->200 EUR/ha) highlighting the +1.8C 100 EUR peak (34.4%, 773 EUR/ha) and upper-right invariant Native N loss inset.

figs2-g3-subsidy.a: Climate warming trajectories and 31 matched remove-climate comparisons (28 ties).
figs2-g3-subsidy.b: Eco-cap 25 Full and 35/40 Sensorless bars paired with realized S_N rainclouds (cap 50 Sensorless 34.4%).

fig5-deployment-closure.a: Regional-equal Test N supply/selected fate bars and apparent vs stock-adjusted symlog NUE.
fig5-deployment-closure.b: Illustrative 349-day AU Perth 2015 organic N stock drawdown (solid) and mineral N (dashed) trajectories.

figs3-price-subsidy.a: 1x solid vs 2x hatched fertilizer price-shock compliance bars across warming (Bare 2x not evaluated).
figs3-price-subsidy.b: Dual-axis subsidy compliance and profit response curves under Historical and +1.8C.

figs4-policy-scorecard.a: Two-group 9-policy typology with bootstrap 95% CIs (5,000 resamples, seed 20261115) and apparent NUE lollipops.
figs4-policy-scorecard.b: Four-metric physical scorecard (0-8 t/ha, 0-250 kg/ha, -60-120 kg/ha, 0-1200 EUR/ha) in SCORE_CMAP.

figs5-p1-all-regimes.a: Full 8-policy apparent NUE rainclouds against the 0.50-0.90 EUNEP band.
figs5-p1-all-regimes.b: 32-year (1995-2026) Train/Dev zero-split reference vs Held-Out Soft/Bare NUE and surplus trajectories.

figs6-p2-admission-mse.a: Three-column prior admission bubble matrix across Rows/World/Closed acceptance rules.
figs6-p2-admission-mse.b: 5x4 Grain N MSE ((kg N/ha)^2) heatmap across LOYO/LORO and world-equal/row-pooled metrics.

figs7-stress-180cell-grid.a-c: Complete 180-cell Soft-PPO advantage surface across Historical, +1.8C and +3.5C with contrast-checked cell labels and all 90 canonical black continuity outlines.

figs8-closure-readout-audit.a: All 50 TRAIN physical readouts in HEATMAP_CMAP (30/30 required positive cells framed).
figs8-closure-readout-audit.b: 349-day daily |N| and |C| mass-balance residuals, aggregate tolerance gauges (4.73x/5.25x) and 6,104,146-record zero-violation replay audit.
